images.title: Jump of 4 lands on 24
images.purpose: Show that equal jumps of 4 from 0 land exactly on the treasure at 24, so 4 is a factor of 24.
images.composition: One long number line with six equal arcs above it and a treasure at the right end, lots of white space.
images.exact_structure: One grey #6B7280 number line from 0 to 24 with 25 evenly spaced ticks; only 0 and 24 numbered. Exactly 6 equal teal #0072B2 arcs of 4 units each from 0 to 24. A small round teal dot at each landing point. At 24 a reddish purple #CC79A7 star for the treasure. Exactly 1 line, 6 arcs, 1 star.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Equal jumps that land exactly on 24 show the jump size divides 24.
images.description: A number line from 0 to 24 with six equal teal jumps of 4 ending on a purple star at 24.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the jumps and say that they end exactly on 24.

image_decisions.why: One clean picture carries the main idea of this concept.
